sourceEditLedger.explanation: Recovered all audit-approved 2.1.118 application semantics, including updates/settings, Vim and terminal input, themes, hooks, remote sessions and controls, plugin release/tagging, memory, telemetry, scheduling, transport, and permission behavior.

Localized OAuth race handling, WIF profile/token boundaries, cache-diagnosis fallback, PID-reuse protection, bounded token reads, plugin validation, Unicode edit recovery, WSL policy protection, and async/tool/classifier stall observability.

Recovered bridge reattach/skipArchive, SessionsV2 SSE reconciliation, remote permission/cost/reload/settings controls, Teleport cursor/event/result/archive semantics, dynamic client-platform headers, and client presence.

Recovered full custom-theme editing and persistence, DOM keybinding dispatch and telemetry, warm-resume hints, background-exit/task displays, terminal/tmux guidance, and remote-control/push idle upsells.

Recovered fork context pointers, async agent completion instrumentation, monitor keepalive semantics, recipient-only SendMessage behavior, verification prompt protocol, REPL hydration propagation, and agent output safety guidance.

Recovered plugin tag validation/execution and CLI/UI reachability, pip-source removal, shadow frontmatter validation, plugin theme discovery, pinner diagnostics, team artifact metadata, and the authenticated managed-agents documentation corpus.

Restored inherited REPLTool and /fork implementations referenced by the authored mirror, including PowerShell prompt/cwd behavior, replay serialization, context hydration, and headless/SDK propagation.
Restored the active shell MonitorTool, dedicated permission request, keepalive reasons, queue cleanup, and task_started.skip_transcript while deliberately excluding compiled-null MonitorMcp behavior.

Restored Bedrock and Vertex upgrade/fallback probes, dialogs, declined-version state, relaunch environment, and setup ordering that are equal in both authenticated bundles but absent from the authored mirror.

Restored transcript_mirror framing and ordering, mirror_error schemas, --session-mirror, thinking-display propagation, session-storage callbacks, remote filtering, and result-flush boundaries present in both bundles.
Restored UserPromptExpansion registry/schema/config/dispatch and slash invocation behavior, plus session memory toggle state/command/filesystem guards required by target-equal runtime dependencies.
Restored scheduled-session exit items, background summaries and exit dialog behavior; the adjacent session_cron state is layered on the inherited exit flow.
Restored tracked MCP OAuth promises with terminal finally-catch, session skill allowlist state/filtering, and target-equal SDK initialization dependencies before applying adjacent consumers.
Localized the authenticated but currently uninvoked slash-template MCP completion callback and prefix-aware replacement formatter without inventing a call site.

Localized authenticated daemon jobs, pipe-key, worker-version and respawn-stale protocol definitions; daemon main/workerRegistry lifecycle remains excluded because the public target compiles out its dispatch symbols.
Removed ConfigTool runtime registration and SDK declarations plus unsupported pip plugin-source branches while retaining only source surfaces authenticated by the target.
Independent semantic audit approved overlay fc47a319 with zero remaining application-semantic gaps; no source edits occurred after approval.
